//go:build sqliteintegration && linux

// Copied into internal/content by the one-run CI workflow. Synthetic data only.
package content

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type ciCrashReceipt struct {
	Completed string `json:"completed"`
	Unknown   string `json:"unknown"`
	Queued    string `json:"queued"`
}

var ciExactArtifact = []byte("{\n  \"example\": \"synthetic fixture\", \"unicode\": \"🙂\"\n}\n")

func TestCIDirectoryTrustRequired(t *testing.T) {
	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ledger")
	if err := validateDataDirectory(dir, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CI must exercise trusted directory validation without skipping: %v", err)
	}
	s, err := OpenStore(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer s.Close()
	if err := validateDataDirectory(dir, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestCISQLiteCrashHelper(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("AWF_CI_CRASH_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		return
	}
	s, err := OpenStore(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	completed := submitSQLite(t, s, "fixture-owner", 4)
	ex, err := s.Claim(ctx, newID())
	if err != nil || ex == nil {
		t.Fatalf("claim completed fixture: %v", err)
	}
	outcome := fixtureSuccess()
	artifact := artifactFor(ciExactArtifact)
	outcome.Artifact, outcome.RawArtifact = &artifact, ciExactArtifact
	if err := s.Finish(ctx, *ex, outcome); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	unknown := submitSQLite(t, s, "fixture-owner", 4)
	queued := submitSQLite(t, s, "fixture-owner", 4)
	ex, err = s.Claim(ctx, newID())
	if err != nil || ex == nil || ex.JobID != unknown.JobID {
		t.Fatalf("claim unknown fixture: %v", err)
	}
	startToken, err := processStartToken(os.Getpid())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := s.RecordBinding(ctx, *ex, ProcessBinding{PID: os.Getpid(), StartToken: startToken, SessionRef: "synthetic-session"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := s.Cancel(ctx, "fixture-owner", unknown.JobID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Leave a real write transaction open at SIGKILL. Small cache encourages
	// page spill; committed WAL data must survive and these writes must not.
	if _, err := s.db.Exec(`PRAGMA cache_size=1; PRAGMA cache_spill=ON`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tx, err := s.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`INSERT INTO artifacts(job_id,schema,media_type,bytes,sha256,raw) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)`, unknown.JobID, artifact.Schema, artifact.MediaType, artifact.Bytes, artifact.SHA256, bytes.Repeat([]byte("x"), 65536)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(`UPDATE jobs SET status='succeeded',cancel_requested=0 WHERE job_id=?`, unknown.JobID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(ciCrashReceipt{completed.JobID, unknown.JobID, queued.JobID}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// The parent kills this process; no deferred SQL close or transaction commit.
	time.Sleep(time.Minute)
	t.Fatal("parent did not SIGKILL crash helper")
}

func TestCISQLiteSIGKILLWALAndRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ledger")
	bin, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	child := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, "-test.run=^TestCISQLiteCrashHelper$")
	child.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin:/bin", "TMPDIR=" + os.TempDir(), "AWF_CI_CRASH_DIR=" + dir}
	var stderr bytes.Buffer
	child.Stderr = &stderr
	stdout, err := child.StdoutPipe()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := child.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = child.Process.Kill(); _ = child.Wait() }()
	var receipt ciCrashReceipt
	if err := json.NewDecoder(stdout).Decode(&receipt); err != nil {
		_ = child.Process.Kill()
		_ = child.Wait()
		t.Fatalf("crash helper handshake: %v %s", err, stderr.String())
	}
	if receipt.Completed == "" || receipt.Unknown == "" || receipt.Queued == "" {
		t.Fatal("incomplete crash handshake")
	}
	if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "content.db-wal")); err != nil || info.Size() == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no live WAL before crash: %v", err)
	}
	startToken, err := processStartToken(child.Process.Pid)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := child.Process.Kill(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	err = child.Wait()
	var exit *exec.ExitError
	if !errors.As(err, &exit) {
		t.Fatalf("expected SIGKILL exit: %v", err)
	}
	status, ok := exit.Sys().(syscall.WaitStatus)
	if !ok || status.Signal() != syscall.SIGKILL {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected crash status: %v", exit)
	}
	s, err := OpenStore(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if s != nil {
			_ = s.Close()
		}
	}()
	checkCtx := context.Background()
	var integrity string
	if err := s.db.QueryRow(`PRAGMA integrity_check`).Scan(&integrity); err != nil || integrity != "ok" {
		t.Fatalf("post-crash integrity: %q %v", integrity, err)
	}
	done, err := s.Get(checkCtx, "fixture-owner", receipt.Completed)
	if err != nil || done.Status != Succeeded || done.Result == nil || done.Result.SHA256 != artifactFor(ciExactArtifact).SHA256 {
		t.Fatalf("committed success lost after SIGKILL: %+v %v", done, err)
	}
	raw, err := VerifyArtifact(*done.Result)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(raw, ciExactArtifact) {
		t.Fatal("committed exact artifact changed after SIGKILL")
	}
	unknown, err := s.Get(checkCtx, "fixture-owner", receipt.Unknown)
	if err != nil || unknown.Status != NeedsVerification || unknown.ErrorCode != "restart_unknown" || !unknown.CancelRequested || unknown.Result != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unknown execution or durable cancel changed: %+v %v", unknown, err)
	}
	var uncommitted int
	if err := s.db.QueryRow(`SELECT count(*) FROM artifacts WHERE job_id=?`, receipt.Unknown).Scan(&uncommitted); err != nil || uncommitted != 0 {
		t.Fatal("uncommitted artifact survived SIGKILL")
	}
	if _, err := s.Claim(checkCtx, newID()); !errors.Is(err, ErrUnavailable) {
		t.Fatal("crash silently resumed execution")
	}
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s = nil
	s, err = OpenStore(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	report, err := s.InspectRecovery(checkCtx)
	if err != nil || !report.Halted || len(report.UnknownAttempts) != 1 || report.QueuedCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("recovery evidence lost on second reopen: %+v %v", report, err)
	}
	binding := report.UnknownAttempts[0]
	if binding.BridgePID != child.Process.Pid || binding.BridgeStartToken != startToken || binding.NativeSessionRef != "synthetic-session" {
		t.Fatalf("persisted process/session binding changed after SIGKILL: %+v", binding)
	}
	if err := s.RecoverExecution(checkCtx, report.RecoveryToken, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next, err := s.Claim(checkCtx, newID())
	if err != nil || next == nil || next.JobID != receipt.Queued {
		t.Fatal("explicit recovery replayed an unknown execution")
	}
	unknown, err = s.Get(checkCtx, "fixture-owner", receipt.Unknown)
	if err != nil || unknown.Status != NeedsVerification {
		t.Fatal("explicit recovery changed unknown outcome")
	}
}
